The part damage nodes therefore carry a LABELLED DESIGNED single-unit pool (m01-play-triggers-parts.designed-part-integrity), which is not a claim about the original's engine hit points; affected content is every INACTIVE ladder over the 39 chains; resolving task #668 (the measured damage table), F27-E.

Nothing in the composed run destroys a zeppelin part today: M01's zeppelins.zrd records state no team, so no target record declares them hostile and the F27 gun step refuses a shot at them by name, and the parts carry no swept-box geometry (the per-node authored transforms of non-object records are not decoded). The destruction path is therefore exercised through the session damage authority the weapon and ordnance steps publish into, and wiring a live geometric producer is affected content; resolving tasks #1436/#1437 follow-ups and F30-E (allegiance).

The two actor-level INACTIVE ladders (block indexes 53 and 55, the one-element chain [piratezep]) read the zeppelin's OWN in-play bit, not a part's: they need the world actor's destruction, whose producer is the same untraced writer and whose pool is the unresolved one #1435 declared. Affected content is OBJECTIVE54/OBJECTIVE56; resolving tasks #1435/#668 or a measured world-actor lifecycle rule.

The windowed firing criterion carried from #1439 is NOT met and not claimed here (capabilities retail, synthetic only): the proximity trigger needs the player within 700 m of workersvoyagezep from a start 5 311 m away. Affected content is the windowed M01 run; resolving task M01-PLAY-TRIGGERS-WINDOWED (#1486).

review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run (part-states.json): cs_app::mission_session::stage_for rebuilt M01's stage, build_headless composed it, the spawn host bound one live part-state entity per spelled chain and MissionHost::step folded the observer's rows, so the artifact records what the composition really holds — 42 spelled member chains of which 39 are part-state chains with a live entity and a damage node, 27 under workersvoyagezep and 12 under piratezep, against the 44 engine node names M01's own zeppelins.zrd records state. Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: the chains, the container resolution, the record's engines lists, the ladder thresholds and the in-play polarity all come from the installation through the production readers. DESIGNED: the part damage nodes' integrity pool (one labelled unit, because the installation states no engine pool anywhere), and the composition's own choice of one ECS entity per part-state chain — this reimplementation's contract, never an original measurement. Nothing here is verified_original and no original executable ran. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_play_triggers_parts_ is unique to this task, so the 6 discovered assertions are exactly this task's tests. candidate_tree is the tree of the commit the acceptance suite and this harness both ran on; the only later delta on the branch is this report's own copy under docs/findings/evidence/ plus the finding's prose. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py (structure, counts and artifact hashes; --require-pass is not used because the report's unknowns must not be deleted).
